description: This file contains utility methods for testing add-ons and keyboard configurations in the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically enabling add-ons and keyboards at specified indices.

classes.name: AddOnTestUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to enable add-ons and keyboards at specific indices for testing purposes.

methods.name: ensureAddOnAtIndexEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the add-on at the specified index within the provided AddOnsFactory.

methods.name: ensureKeyboardAtIndexEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the keyboard at the specified index by retrieving the keyboard factory from the application context.
